Although it matches the theatrical frame rate , 1080p/24 would require a standard film conversion (3:2) to become 60 field or frame video compatible, 1080p/30 would require a dual-frame exposure to accomplish the same. In both cases, this conversion severely increases motion artifacts and reduces the high-quality image intended.
